title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 9, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $9,500.00 for
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 9, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $9,500.00 for
  a Quarter Horse Gelding “Ripp” to join Metropolitan Division’s Mounted Platoon, as set forth.
  [BPC #26-307]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: Approval of $9,500 donation of Quarter Horse Gelding to join the Metropolitan Division's Mounted Platoon.
